create_decision_tree_classifier: create a DecisionTreeClassifier trained on iris dataset features for classification
plot_decision_boundary: plot the decision boundary surface of a trained decision tree classifier on paired iris features
display_decision_tree_structure: display the structure of a trained decision tree with filled node colors using plot_tree
load_iris_dataset: load the built-in iris dataset with features, targets, and target names from sklearn
plot_decision_surface_pairs: plot decision surfaces for all feature pairs of the iris dataset using DecisionBoundaryDisplay
